arxiv-2105-04142.title: Spreading and Suppression of Infection Clusters on the Ginibre Continuum Percolation Clusters
arxiv-2105-04142.creator: Machiko Katori, Makoto Katori
arxiv-2105-04142.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Machiko Katori, Makoto Katori. Off-lattice SIR models are constructed on continuum percolation clusters defined on the Ginibre point process (GPP) and on the Poisson point process (PPP). The static percolation transitions in the continuum percolation models as well as the infection-spreading transitions in the SIR models, which are regarded as the dynamic percolation transitions, are enhanced in the GPP-based model compared with the PPP-based model. This enhancement is caused by hyperuniformity of the GPP.

arxiv-2110-15924.title: Seismic response of cylinder assemblies in axial flow
arxiv-2110-15924.creator: Roberto Capanna 1, Guillaume Ricciardi 1, Emmanuelle Sarrouy 2, Christophe Eloy 3
arxiv-2110-15924.description: Abstract Earthquakes are a great challenge for the safety of nuclear reactors. To address this challenge, we need to better understand how the reactor core responds to seismic forcing. The reactor core is made of fuel assemblies, which are themselves composed of flexible fuel rods immersed in a strong axial flow.

arxiv-2211-01707.description: Abstract The realization of chiral Majorana modes using hetero-structures is a challenging task. arxiv-2308-00479.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation and Representative Vector Summarization for Large Unstructured Textual Data in Medical Education
arxiv-2308-00479.creator: S. S. Manathunga, Y. A. Illangasekera
arxiv-2308-00479.description: Abstract Large Language Models are increasingly being used for various tasks including content generation and as chatbots. pmc-11235215.creator: Ridhima Vij, Hosu Kim, Hyeonggeun Park, Thanh Cheng, Djamchid Lotfi, Donna Chang
pmc-11235215.description: Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a debilitating disease with clinical manifestations ranging from incomplete neurological deficits affecting sensory and motor functions to complete paralysis. pmc-11490670.creator: Kohei Mori, Yutaka Shiono, Soichiro Shimura, Shuhei Hirano, Dai Koguchi, Masaomi Ikeda, Hideyasu Tsumura, Daisuke Ishii, Kazumasa Matsumoto
pmc-11490670.description: Fournier's gangrene is a severe type of necrotizing fasciitis that affects the perineal and genital regions. Because of its rapid progression, Fournier's gangrene is associated with high mortality and morbidity rates. Surgical treatment of Fournier's gangrene requires leaving the wound open and performing multiple debridement procedures.

pmc-13469917.title: Six months predictors of DAPSA Remission With Guselkumab in Psoriatic Arthritis in a Multicenter Real-World Study
pmc-13469917.creator: Alessandro Conforti, Alarico Ariani, Martina Gentile, Giulia Cataldi, Andrea Becciolini, Antonio Marchesoni, Simone Parisi, Olga Addimanda, Eleonora Celletti, Luca Idolazzi, Romina Andracco, Marino Paroli, Patrizia Del Medico, Antonella Farina, Palma Scolieri, Aurora Ianniello, Federica Lumetti, Cec
pmc-13469917.description: Real-world evidence on 12-month outcomes of guselkumab (GUS) in psoriatic arthritis (PsA) remains limited. This multicenter observational study aimed to identify predictors of 12-month DAPSA remission (DAPSA < 4) in patients with PsA treated with GUS. Secondary objectives were to assess remission rates and changes in disease activity at 6 and 12 months.

uslaw-usc-t18-s3235.title: 18 U.S.C. § 3235 — Venue in capital cases
uslaw-usc-t18-s3235.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s3235.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part II (Criminal Procedure); Chapter 211 (Jurisdiction And Venue). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The trial of offenses punishable with death shall be had in the county where the offense was committed, where that can be done without great inconvenience.
